data: Tesla's operating income fell by roughly 51% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2025. In fiscal 2023 it reported GAAP operating income of about $8.89 billion. For fiscal 2025 I recall roughly $4.36 billion, the sum of quarterly figures of about $0.40 billion, $0.92 billion, $1.62 billion and $1.41 billion. That works out to a drop of about $4.5 billion, or about 51%. The fiscal 2023 figure is well established, but I'm working from memory on fiscal 2025 and haven't checked it against the 10-K, so verify it there before relying on the exact percentage. For context, fiscal 2024 sat in between at about $7.08 billion, so most of the decline came in 2025.
